senses.gloss: (v. כַּדּוּר) to be thrown around in a circle of players.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:11">Koh. R. to XII, 11</cite> <he>מה הכדור הזה מִתְכַּדֵּר וכ׳</he> as the ball is thrown around from hand to hand.
